chapters.title: Chapter 1
chapters.content:
Chapter 1

The black nylon loop hovers steadily around Jane’s left ankle as she sits down in the passenger seat of Cade’s SUV. She swings her right leg into the truck. Reno slams the door shut.

Both of Jane’s feet are resting on the floor inside of the black nylon loop. The loop is quickly yanked back under the seat, causing Jane’s knees to bend while her ankles are cinched together. When the heels of her shoes get pulled underneath the seat, Jane looks down in shock.

In the seat behind her, Black plants his boot on the end of that nylon strap, holding it in place. He rises up the backside of her seat and reaches over the headrest to slip a blindfold over Jane’s eyes, which are still aimed down at her feet in confusion.

Next to Black, Random slides onto the center console and between the front seats. He holds a second nylon strap out taut over Jane’s lap. As she instinctively reaches up for her masked face, her wrists hit the strap, which he wraps around them. Random pulls the strap tight, bringing Jane’s hands together in front of her. He then lunges forward, taking Jane’s wrists down with him.

Cade opens the driver side door and gets into his truck. The interior lights go off. When Jane opens her mouth to scream, Cade reaches over top of Random’s back to shove a white cloth into her mouth as a gag.

Bent over Jane’s lap, Random rapidly feeds the end of his strap between her calves and under the seat. Black is waiting on the backside to pull that strap through.

Jane grunts through the gag and bends her elbows, jerking against the strap, but Black jerks back, bringing Jane’s hands straight down into her lap.

Random backs off of the center console and sits down in the backseat behind Cade, who starts the engine. The truck’s stereo and air conditioning begin blasting.

Down on the floormat behind Jane’s seat, Black finishes knotting the two straps together. He pushes up off the floor and relaxes into the backseat next to Random. They glance over at one another while Cade puts the truck in reverse.

Outside of the truck, Reno loiters in the sparingly lit parking lot, watching on and drinking Jane’s cup of coffee. The SUV’s tires squeal as it barrels out of the parking lot. Once the SUV is out of sight, Reno strolls through the night air to his Porsche.

***

​The 20-minute ride in the SUV is cold with air conditioning and loud with pounding rock music. Cade, Random and Black avoid conversation while Jane intermittently wrestles against the nylon wrist and ankle restraints that trap her in the front passenger seat. Cade steers into the long driveway, on up to the side of the opulent Mercer Estate. He is the first one to bail out of the truck and head inside. The brisk air stops blasting, and the truck’s interior grows still.

Parked at the side entrance door of the house, Random and Black get out of the backseat of Cade’s SUV. Black roams off to the side door and into the house.

Random circles around the SUV to open the passenger side door for Jane. Inside the truck, her body heaves with a deep breath. She exhales through her nose, worn out from the struggling and the panic, silenced by the cloth gag. Jane turns her head towards Random as if she can see him through the spandex blindfold.

“I’m letting out the tension between your feet so you can walk.” He reaches inside and grabs the nylon strap between Jane’s ankles, pulling some slack out. “But take small steps. If you try and run, they’ll pull right back together, do you understand?” Random glances up to see her weak nod.

He grips the outsides of Jane’s thighs, presses her legs together and spins her sideways in the seat. Jane’s legs hang out the door. Her body tilts forward to him. “Slide off the seat.” Random reaches up for Jane’s shoulders and guides her down to the ground. He pulls her a few feet away from the SUV and shuts the door.

Jane waits, rigidly motionless. The strap that’s binding her wrists together in front of her is knotted to the one around her ankles. So if she bends her elbows up, it will tighten the loop down below and cinch her ankles together.

Random stands beside Jane and clutches the back of her head, right under her ponytail. He begins walking at a slow pace. Jane takes small cautious steps and lets Random escort her to the side entrance door.

***

“Sam, do you know anything about this game that Cade’s playing tonight?” Upstairs in Hannah’s suite, she scoots her laptop up her thighs, closer to her. Her phone is still on speaker, lying on a rust-colored pillow beside her in bed. A glass of white wine sits next to the baroque lamp that lights Hannah’s antique nightstand.

“No, why?” Sam asks on the other line.

“The target is a congressman’s daughter with no affiliation or knowledge of us.” Hannah taps the keyboard, scrolling down Sam’s message board on the screen.

“Are you serious?” she asks through a disapproving growl. “You guys are getting a little reckless lately.”

“Cade actually has a shot at success.” Hannah curtails her concern. “This girl’s the black sheep and a closet sub. I read her stories.”

“Her stories?”

“Yeah, that’s how he found her.” Hannah picks up the glass of wine on her nightstand. “She posted a few kink tales on a story site, so Cade messaged her an invitation to play one of them.”

“Then she knows that much, at least.”

“Targets always know what they have coming.” Hannah swirls her wineglass. “They just don’t know when or where it’ll happen.”

“But they DO know who’s ultimately behind it. So this one’s still a gamble.”

“Oh, I know.” Hannah concurs. “That’s probably why you haven’t heard about it.” She sips her wine and sets the glass back down.

“Well, I don’t really talk to Cade.”

“Random and Black are both in on it, too.”

“Is that so?” Sam asks with an audible sneer.

“Front and center.” Hannah gleefully tattles on them.

***

Still grasping onto the back of Jane’s head, Random leads her down the hallway of chamber doors. Cade is stationed in front of chamber 5. He opens the door and goes inside.

Random steers Jane into the room. The metal door swings shut behind them. Black is already inside the silent chamber, which is faintly lit by two dimmed wall sconces on either side of the door. The four of them look like shadows moving through the darkness. Cade disappears into obscurity.

Black walks up to Jane. He unwraps the nylon strap from her wrists and tosses it on the floor. Jane’s arms swing down to her sides.

Random steps behind Jane while Black grips the zipper of her pink hoodie. He unzips it in one swift motion, ignoring the sounds of protest coming out of her gagged mouth.

Jane’s arms fly up to hold her shirt on.

From behind, Random promptly reaches around to the front of her body and takes her wrists in his hands. He brings Jane’s arms behind her back as she wrenches against him. Random bows his head down over Jane’s ear. “You’re outnumbered and there’s nowhere to go. Just let it happen.”

Jane relaxes her arms, and Random straightens back up. Black crouches down to unloop the strap from her ankles.

Random gently shakes Jane’s arms, working the shirt off her shoulders. It slides right down her forearms. He lets go of Jane’s wrists, and her shirt falls to the floor. Her black bra is left in place.

Black rises back up and takes Jane’s hands. He tugs her a couple feet forward then drops her hands. Behind Black, the silhouette of a detention device comes into view.

He and Random stand on either side of Jane. They each grab onto one of her wrists, pulling her arms out straight. They guide her to the detention device and lay her arms down on its padded armrests. Jane’s palms slip around rubber handgrips.

Black and Random flip the attached cuffs over Jane’s wrists, securing her to the device. Then Black reaches back and slides his fingers into the elastic waistband of Jane’s pants.

She lets out an apprehensive whimper when Black begins removing her pants. She hikes her knee up to stop him.

Black yanks the pants over Jane’s bent knee and pulls them down to the ground. She’s left in a pair of black panties. Jane lowers her foot back down to the floor.

“Take a step forward, princess.” Black instructs her.

Having no viable alternative, Jane steps forward. Her stomach hits a cushioned beam, like a pommel horse. Jane kicks her foot in between the metal legs of the beam.

Black crouches down beside the metal leg. He catches Jane’s kicking foot, bends her knee and fastens her ankle to the leg of the beam. Random punches a button on a control box mounted to the front of it.

The padded armrests move forward, drawing Jane’s body over the beam. Her bound leg begins straightening out. Black latches onto Jane’s other leg and fastens her ankle to the other leg of the beam. The padded armrest stops moving. Jane’s body rests on the cushioned beam, fully supported by it and secured to it.

Random takes the soggy cloth gag out of her mouth. He wanders over to a counter along the wall where he casually scans the shadowy array of whips, crops and paddles.

Jane gasps for air, taking in lungfuls, until she catches her breath. “What...is going on?” Her head darts from side to side in an attempt to pick up clues about her surroundings. Her ponytail swishes across her bare shoulder blades.

Black walks in front of the beam and stops across from Jane’s blindfolded face. His tenor is low and steady, almost comforting. “You don’t know yet?” He strokes Jane’s cheek and tucks a loose strand of dark hair behind her ear.

“No I don’t know,” Jane answers frantically. “Please let me go.”

Black steps around to the side of the device, standing by the padded armrest. He reaches down and cups Jane’s chin in his palm.

She flinches at his touch but remains quiet.

“But your freedom is just an illusion, Jane.” Black holds her chin in one hand and places his other on her back, between her shoulder blades. He slowly runs his fingers down the arch of Jane’s back. “It’s a set of rights and liberties decided for you by a society who doesn’t want to know you.” Black’s fingers reach the small of her back. “That illusion cheats you out of reaping the primal rewards of life.” He flattens out his hand and rests his palm on Jane’s back, just above her panties. “And it punishes you for thinking you want those rewards in the first place.”

Jane shakes her head. “No, you’re wrong about me.” She professes to him.

Black spews a soft laugh and lets go of Jane’s chin. He leaves his other hand on her lower back. “Do you really think this is all an accident, hmm?” Black slides his hand off of her and begins circling back around to Jane’s face. “You know that you weren’t randomly selected tonight, right?”

“I-I...” Jane stutters, maintaining a stable mindset but undeniably drunk with disconcertion. She needs more answers to stay in some level of control over her situation. “I think I deserve an explanation, here.” She states.

Standing in front of her face, Black takes the base of Jane’s ponytail in his hand. He uses a firm grip. “No one’s ever treated you like this before, have they?”

“NO.” Her response is adamant.

Smirking, Black holds Jane’s head still and stoops down in front of her. “Then you’re very lucky for the opportunity.”

“That’s not true, please stop.”

Black straightens back up and talks down to Jane in a normal tone. “Oh, come on. Are you hurt?” he asks as he lets go of Jane’s ponytail.

“Am I going to be hurt?”

Black sets off for the chamber door after delivering his last line of dialogue.

“I think you know exactly what’s going to happen to you.” Random alludes.

Jane hears a different, distant voice answer her question. She responds by rigorously struggling against her restraints.

Black exits the chamber. The door slams shut behind him.

She turns her masked face over her shoulder at the sound of the door. She resumes jerking against the wrist cuffs with arrant frustration.

“Does that scare you, knowing what you’re in for?” Random’s distant voice echoes through the still chamber.

Jane hears the nearby squeak of a wheel. The noise grabs her attention, and she stops her futile straining.

Cade is seated on a chair, rolling towards Jane. He has a stack of paper in his lap. Cade rolls over and stops across from her.

“What’s wrong with you, you freaks!” Jane shouts in Cade’s face unwittingly.

He widens his eyes, riveted on her every reaction.

“Fight it all you want. It just makes it better for everyone.” Random looms up on the detention device, holding a leather-covered paddle. He spins the handle in his hand with a brazen twirl.

​Cade reaches up, clasping the back of Jane’s head in one hand and putting his other hand over her mouth. His face is directly across from hers.

Upon hearing the sound of a paddle cut through the nearby air, Jane tilts her head back and fills Cade’s palm with a muted scream.

Cade bends in closer to Jane’s reddening ear. “It’s okay to like it.” Hushed, he adds, “I won’t tell.” He removes his hands from her face.

She draws a vexed breath. The false alarm has kindled her rant. “Who ARE you? Why are you doing this to me?”

“You must really think you’re some well-kept secret, Jane. Why won’t you just admit it?” Paddle in hand, Random leisurely makes his way over to Cade’s chair.

Cade pops the cap off a highlighter pen.

“Please.” She frets. “Just tell me. Why are you doing this?”

Cade looks at the stack of paper in his lap. He highlights a line on the top sheet.

“I don’t really want to tell you that...” Random takes the sheet of paper that Cade is passing up to him. “Because you already know,” he reads from the paper, “that ‘the impact of the surreal experience would’ve been completely compromised by any forewarning of it. Even though I didn’t see it at the time...” Random takes a dramatic pause to watch Jane’s jaw slack in recognition of her own words, “...the element of surprise was a major player.’ Is this ringing any bells, Jane?”

Comprehension swallows up Jane’s fear. She sheds her charade of denial. This enhanced replica of her own story was the subject of the consent form she returned.

“That’s right.” Random passes the sheet of paper back to Cade and leans in close to Jane’s dewy face. “You signed up for this.”

“I didn’t...” her refute thins to a rasp, “expect anything to actually come of it.”

“That’s the magic element of surprise you were after.” Random lifts his head up away from hers. “Only the best for you, princess.” He descends upon Jane’s backside, rhythmically spinning the handle of the paddle in his hand. “And what could top your own depraved imagination?”

Cade places his hands on Jane’s cheeks, taking her mortified face into his hands.

Jane’s hysteria has completely dissipated, giving way to grave anticipation. “I can’t believe this is actually happening.”

There’s a sharp whoosh of air as Random raises the paddle up above Jane’s ass. He swings it down.

***

Back upstairs in Hannah’s suite, she’s tipping her head back and drinking the last sip of her white wine.

“So hey, what’s got you in such a freakishly good mood today, anyway?” Sam’s question rings out of Hannah’s phone sitting on the rust-colored pillow.

Hannah sets the empty wineglass on her nightstand. “I am content with the world.” Her focus settles back down onto the monitor in her lap. “And all of my boys are on my good side. That’s rare.”

“Well, I’m glad I could help see you through your time of need with Brian.”

“I’m just glad it’s over. And yes, thank you for letting me vent yesterday.”

“Huh.” There’s a conjuring undercurrent in Sam’s reply.

“What? What are you plotting?”

“I’m gonna have to reinstate the prank war, immediately.”

“From Amsterdam?” Hannah scoffs at her. “I hope you’re not asking me to do anything.”

“Why? Why not, Hannah?”

Her face crunches up in antipathy. “No Sam, I can’t do anything to Black.”

“Why the hell not?”

“I just, I can’t have him mad at me. You have no idea how rough it is around here when he’s mad at me.”

“He won’t know.” Sam insists. “He. Will. Not. Know.”

Hannah churns out a long, reluctant sigh. Even with an ocean separating them, the typically ferocious California blonde succumbs to the Amsterdam Dominatrix.

“I do not reveal who I work with, ever.”

“If I get caught, I’m throwing you under the bus.” She warns Sam.

“I live under the prank war bus. There’s no more room down here.”

Slamming her eyes shut, Hannah groans in surrender. “I knew if I reached out to you, there’d be some catch.”

“Suck it up bitch. Listen, here’s what I want you to do.”

***

The next morning, Cade’s black SUV is parked outside of the Community Health Center next to Jane’s white BMW sedan. The rest of the parking lot is pretty empty.

Mild morning sun shines through the windshield of the truck. Jane is lying in the reclined passenger seat, fast asleep. A white cashmere blanket is draped over her limp body. Jane’s eyes blink open to the burgeoning ray of sun hitting her face. She gazes around then sits up, groggily alarmed. She glances out the window and sees her car.

When Jane tosses the cashmere blanket aside, she notices that she has been fully re-dressed in the clothes she was wearing the night before.

Jane gets out of the SUV and heads to her car. Peering into the driver side window, she sees her purse inside next to an envelope on the passenger seat. Her car doors are locked. Jane pats the pockets of her pink hoodie and feels her keys. She takes them out of her pocket and turns to the Community Health Center.

Inside the building, Jane rushes to the bathroom. She flips on the lights and jogs up to the bathroom mirror. Aside from her unkempt hair and makeup, Jane’s face looks fine. She pushes up her shirt sleeves to take a close look at her wrists. No marks, no bruises.

Jane bends down to inspect her legs. She yanks up the cuff of her black pants. She sees no redness or bruising on her ankles. Lastly, Jane pulls down her pants and examines her backside in the mirror. A puzzled frown comes over her face when she realizes there are no marks or redness anywhere on her body. “Nothing at all,” she says to herself. Her bra and underwear were never even removed, so there’s nothing further to check. She leaves the bathroom.

Back outside, Jane gets into the driver’s seat of her BMW. She grabs her purse to check through it. Her phone and wallet are both in there. She sighs in relief then zeroes in on the envelope. Her name is printed on the front. With trembling fingers, Jane picks up the envelope and opens it. She pulls out a card. The card has the American flag on the front of it. Jane flips open the card and reads the handwritten note:

Jane, you’re free to think, feel and type whatever you wish. Hopefully you understand that now. But if you need more convincing, leave a message 310-323-4323.

After an overwhelmed beat, Jane fishes her phone out of her purse. She dials the number on the card. Her call goes straight to a voicemail beep.

“I have to admit, you’re one hell of a secret admirer.” Jane hesitates and quickly ends the call. She sets her phone on the passenger seat and starts up her car.

***

“And... She’s gone.” Cade is seated at his desk in front of his computer, hyped and bright-eyed. He’s monitoring Jane’s location on a GPS screen. His phone is lying nearby on the desk. It vibrates to notify him of a new message. Cade rolls back from his computer screen towards the bay window behind him.

Standing in the doorway of Cade’s office, Black stretches his arms over his head, palpably tired and disheveled. “Okay. Let’s go get your truck.”

Cade hops up to follow Black out of the office. He picks up his phone on his way to the door.

Yawning, Black motions over his shoulder to Cade’s phone. “I’ve gotta hand it to you. I didn’t expect her to call that quick. Figured she’d ruminate a while.”

“I kinda thought it would happen right away, or not at all.” Cade shuts the office door behind him. They leave Cade’s suite to take the elevator down to the main level, heading for the garage.

A couple minutes later, Black walks into the multi-car garage. Cade is following close behind him, staring down at his phone.

Black stops in his tracks and thrusts his hands out. “What the–”

Cade bumps into him. He lowers his phone to see Black’s Mercedes completely covered in cling wrap.

“Ah.” Realization hits Black. “Sam.” He drops his hands down to his sides. “Really?”

“This again?” Cade shuts off his phone display.

“Looks like it.” Black runs his hand over his forehead and combs his fingers through his dark, messy hair.

“Why don’t we just take Reno’s car?”

Blaring a loud sigh, Black gets his phone out of his pocket. “I’ll let him know.”

***

“I thought I should let somebody know, in case something happens to me.” Jane is having breakfast with her platonic friend, Matt. He’s her age, manscaped and fashionable for Saturday morning at an everyday pancake house. They’re sitting in a booth up against a window that looks out to the parking lot.

“Wait, back up, you called the number?” he asks disbelievingly. “You left a message?”

“Insane?” Jane takes a sip of her coffee. An unopened menu sits on the table in front of her. She’s still dressed in her hoodie and black pants from the night before.

“For you, yeah. I’d be all over it, but for you, WOW.” Matt marvels and opens his menu.

“I’ve got to find out who’s behind this, Matt. These people know things about me. They volunteered things, like knowing who Doctor Weaver is.”

“And they know how to push your buttons.”

“Like I never thought possible.”

“It’s crazy someone would go to those lengths out of the blue.”

“Right.” Jane evades the fact she initially accepted the invitation to play such a risky game. Instead, she keeps the conversation on track. “Let’s take what we do know. My school stuff and stories are on my computer. They obviously hacked into it unless you’re involved.”

Matt glimpses up from his menu with a huff. “Come on.”

They look out the window at Matt’s Jeep in the parking lot, shaded by a palm tree. A large gay pride rainbow sticker adorns his bumper. On top of being a trusted friend, he has no sexual interest in her.

“That’s just it. How would some internet strangers know these details about my life? How was it so easy to pull something like that off?”

“Okay, then they hacked into your computer. You’re dealing with people who are really connected and serious about this stuff. Are you sure that’s something you want to get tangled up with?”

“Am I sure?” She flutters her lashes at him. “I’m not sure what to order for breakfast, Matt.” Jane flips open her menu.

***

The Southbend diner in Oklahoma is bustling with Saturday morning patrons eating plates of comforting breakfast food. Trip and Babe are seated across from each other in a booth. Bright sun beats through the window beside their table. Trip has a plate of French toast in front of him. Babe is popping a forkful of pancakes into her mouth.

“So yesterday.” Trip smiles boyishly and cuts into his French toast. “That was the best day I’ve had in a real long time.” He enthuses before taking a bite.

“Oh, I know.” A lively grin lights up Babe’s sun-kissed cuteness. “That was the most I think I’ve ever done in one day, and I am still excited from it, today.”

“I am too.” Trip chuckles and reflects on the day before. “I didn’t think I was ever gonna stop laughing when that horse took a bite of your sandwich.”

Babe starts giggling and covers her mouth with her free hand. She points her fork at him. “I know, and the more you laughed, the more I couldn’t stop.”

“It was funny.” Still smiling, Trip cuts off another piece of French toast. He catches a sugary waft of the maple syrup drenching Babe’s pancakes.

“I think daddy warmed up to you a little more last night at supper, too.”

“Yeah, he actually made a joke.” Trip eats his bite of French toast.

Babe puts down her fork. In a blissful cadence, she adds, “But you took the prize with your drive-in movie surprise last night. Drivin’ around ‘til you found a signal on your thingamajig.”

“Tablet.”

“And sittin’ in the truck bed under the stars, watchin’ my favorite movie with me,” Babe says to him. She has a faraway shine in her eyes. “That is the sweetest thing anyone’s ever done for me.”

“No, it couldn’t be.” Trip brushes off her comment and drinks his coffee.

“Yes it could! I told you that story ‘bout the drive-in closin’ down before I could ever go to it, and you gave me that experience. Thank you.” Babe looks across the table at him with genuine appreciation.

Trip sets down his coffee mug and holds his hand out to her. “It was my pleasure.”

Babe slips her hand into his. He traces the inside of her wrist with his index finger, and they share a tender moment.

“I do feel bad for keepin’ you from your family obligations yesterday.”

Trip squeezes Babe’s hand and hangs his head. “I need to go to the hospital today.” He lets go of her hand.

“Do you want me to go with?”

“Yes and no.” Trip lets out a short, uneasy laugh.

Babe picks up her glass of iced tea. “If you don’t, that’s perfectly fine. I was just offerin’.”

“I know.”

***

Still in her pajamas, Becky sits down at her computer with a bottled water. She opens her email inbox. “No new messages,” she says under her breath. Nodding, she gets up from her desk chair and carries the water into her bedroom.

A couple of outfits are draped over the side rails of her treadmill. Becky puts the water down on her nightstand next to her two phones. She picks up her old phone and calls her co-worker friend, Jackie.

“Morning Becky, do you still want to meet up for lunch?”

“Yeah, where do you want to go?”

“Let’s just do our usual.” Jackie suggests. “One o’clock?”

“Okay, I’ll see you then.” Becky hangs up and sets the phone on her nightstand. She walks over to the treadmill and picks up a colorful sundress. While carrying the dress over to her bed, Becky’s eyes dash over to the new phone on her nightstand.

With stark compulsion, Becky drops the dress on the bed and snatches up her new phone. She calls Black, gets his voicemail beep and leaves him a message. “Hello again, Black. I am honestly sorry for how I acted the other night.”

***

Black’s phone is lying out on the console of Reno’s Porsche, on speaker, playing the rest of Becky’s message throughout the car. “And I really do hope that you believe me, because it’s true. I’m finally catching on to the rules of your game now, so if you’ll give me one more shot, I promise I’ll follow them. I hope it’s not a ‘too little too late’ situation. Please get back to me.”

The message ends, and Black erases it off his phone.

Cade is riding in the passenger seat next to him. “She’s persistent.”

“She’s definitely persistent, but that’s only one part of the package.” Black puts the car in neutral and slows down at a stoplight.

“Not everything comes all at once.”

“I know that, and I love a challenge as much as anybody. Unless it’s impossible to conquer.”

“I doubt it’s impossible.” Cade surmises.

When the light turns green, Black puts the car in first and accelerates through the intersection. “But at some point, you have to ask yourself if there’s still a point in pursuing it.”

“I’m probably not the best source for advice on this topic. I guess that getting the call from Jane has me feeling optimistic today.” He gestures to Black’s phone. “Because I know that if I had this girl blowing up my phone with apologies, I’d probably hesitate before throwing away the time I’ve invested in her so far.”

“I am hesitating. And I have plenty of time to hesitate, because I don’t think she’ll give up anytime soon.” Black steers into the Community Health Center parking lot. He drives past a row of empty stalls and pulls up next to Cade’s SUV.

Cade gets out of the car and leans down to talk to Black. “Hey, before you get into any deep analytical thought on this, please call Jane back for me, okay?” He shuts the passenger side door of the Porsche and walks up to his SUV.

Black picks his phone up from the console to dial up Jane.

***

Jane is pushing a cart through the produce section of a grocery store, across from the pancake house where she just had breakfast with Matt. She stops at the apples and oranges. While Jane tears off a produce bag, her phone rings. She takes it out of her purse and checks the display. Jane slants her head curiously when she sees it’s a private number.

“Hello?” She answers her phone in a quiet mumble.

“Guess who,” Black says on the other line.

Jane skims the bins of apples. “I wish I knew.” She responds frankly.

“Interested in finding out?”

“Very. Is it you?”

“Nope.”

“What about Josh?” she asks.

“I don’t know anybody named Josh.”

“The guy who showed up at my massage clinical.”

“Nah, he was just helping out, like me.”

“Helping out the person behind this, you mean?” Jane opens up the produce bag and turns to the apples.

“That’s right. And he’s nobody you know, in case you were wondering.”

“Who is he, then?”

“What difference does it make if you don’t know him?”

“Well, because he seems to know an awful lot about me.” She picks through the pile of red apples.

“Have you ever been in a relationship that cuts straight through all the bullshit and starts right up with the fundamentals?”

Bemused, she says, “No, never.”

“Would you like to be?”

Jane blushes and selects an apple from the pile. She drops it into her bag.

“I’ll read your silence as a ‘yes’.”

“I’m curious about it.” She admits.

“Your curiosity is well-established. If you’re hunting for clues, why don’t we meet up for lunch tomorrow?”

“Okay.” Jane readily agrees.

“I’ll give you a call tomorrow.”

***

Dressed in swim trunks and t-shirts, Cade and Black step out the glass patio door onto the limestone lanai. They trek across the sprawling Mercer Estate pool area, lush with potted plants and ample seating.

“She agreed to lunch right away.” Black informs him.

“Good, good.” Cade sounds encouraged. They veer around the unlit fire pit surrounded by Adirondack chairs.

“It’s a nice change of pace, getting away from Becky and back to dealing with an actual submissive. It’s like night and day.”

Cade chuckles at Black’s remark. They walk past fellow Tops Geneva and Vienna in lounge chairs by the pool, acknowledging the two raven-haired women with a wave.

“You never told me how you arranged it so that Reno would be assigned to Jane for the massage.”
